criteria.C: Known and unknown fallback; observed preparation content, no execution claim.

criteria.D: Requested files/findings only; review-only untouched; editorial review or disclosed fallback; gaps separate from defects.

criteria.B: One preparation contract; source sections do not create unrelated public operations.
criteria.V: @ai only because verification exercises an agent applying the guidance.
